hook.en: We say a die shows six with probability one-sixth. We can reason it out from equally likely faces, or roll the die thousands of times and count. Both roads lead to the same number.
hook.kn: ದಾಳ 6 ತೋರಿಸುವ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ 1/6 ಎನ್ನುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಸಮಸಂಭವ ಮುಖಗಳಿಂದ ತರ್ಕಿಸಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಬಾರಿ ಉರುಳಿಸಿ ಎಣಿಸಬಹುದು. ಎರಡೂ ದಾರಿ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: We say a die shows six with probability one-sixth. We can reason it out from equally likely faces, or roll the die thousands of times and count. Both roads lead to the same number.
narration.kn: ದಾಳ 6 ತೋರಿಸುವ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ 1/6 ಎನ್ನುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಸಮಸಂಭವ ಮುಖಗಳಿಂದ ತರ್ಕಿಸಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಬಾರಿ ಉರುಳಿಸಿ ಎಣಿಸಬಹುದು. ಎರಡೂ ದಾರಿ ಒಂದೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Classical (Laplace): if an experiment has n exhaustive, mutually exclusive and equally likely outcomes, m of which favour A, then $P(A) = m/n$. Statistical (von Mises): $P(A) = \lim_{n\to\infty} m/n$, the limit of the relative frequency in n repeated trials. Axiomatic (Kolmogorov): $P(A) \ge 0$, $P(S) = 1$, and $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B)$ for mutually exclusive A, B.
body.kn: ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ: n ಸಮಸಂಭವ, ಪರಸ್ಪರ ವರ್ಜಿತ, ಸಮಗ್ರ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ m ಅನುಕೂಲವಾದರೆ P(A) = m/n. ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಿಕ: ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಅನಂತದತ್ತ ಸಾಗಿದಾಗ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ m/n ನ ಮಿತಿ. ಸ್ವಯಂಸಿದ್ಧ: P(A) ≥ 0, P(S) = 1, ಪರಸ್ಪರ ವರ್ಜಿತ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಗೆ P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).

say.en: Classical: count favourable cases over total cases. For sum seven with two dice it is six out of thirty-six.
Statistical: toss a coin again and again. The proportion of heads wobbles at first, then settles near one half.
Axiomatic: three rules every probability must obey.
With combinations: two balls from five red and three black. Both red: five choose two over eight choose two, which is five fourteenths.

narration.en: On the board: Counting and repeating.

Repeat a random experiment again and again. The curve is the relative frequency m/n of the event after n trials. It jumps about at first, then settles near the classical probability (dashed line): the statistical definition of probability.

caption.en: Repeat a random experiment again and again. The curve is the relative frequency m/n of the event after n trials. It jumps about at first, then settles near the classical probability (dashed line): the statistical definition of probability.
caption.kn: ಒಂದು ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ ಪ್ರಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ವಕ್ರ n ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳ ನಂತರ ಘಟನೆಯ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ m/n. ಮೊದಲು ಏರಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ನಂತರ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆಯ (ಚುಕ್ಕೆ ರೇಖೆ) ಹತ್ತಿರ ನೆಲೆಸುತ್ತದೆ: ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆಯ ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಿಕ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯೆ.

aim.en: To toss a coin and throw a die many times, and to compare the experimental probability with the theoretical probability.

narration.en: Toss the coin many times in the virtual lab and watch the relative frequency of heads settle near one half. This is the statistical definition at work.

Statistical: the limit of relative frequency.
Axioms: P(A) ≥ 0, P(S) = 1, additivity for exclusive events.

homework.en: Two cards are drawn from a pack of 52. Find the probability that both are red.

narration.en: Recap. Classical: P(A) = m/n for equally likely cases. Statistical: the limit of relative frequency. Axioms: P(A) ≥ 0, P(S) = 1, additivity for exclusive events. Count with combinations: P = C(favourable)/C(total).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ: ಸಮಸಂಭವ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಿಗೆ P(A) = m/n. ಸಾಂಖ್ಯಿಕ: ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಮಿತಿ. ಸ್ವಯಂಸಿದ್ಧಗಳು: P(A) ≥ 0, P(S) = 1, ವರ್ಜಿತ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಕಲನ. ಸಂಯೋಜನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಎಣಿಸಿ.
